los: M01 Organizational Forms - complex ownership structure purpose
prompt_or_question: Complex corporate structures are often explained too narrowly as tax avoidance.
wrong_choice_or_output: Defaulted to tax avoidance as the main purpose of complex issuer structures.
correct_resolution: Complex issuer structures often combine several objectives: maintain control, raise outside capital, limit personal liability, separate economic ownership from management control, and allow public investors to participate without directly controlling underlying assets.
